provenance.basis: authored for this harness. Modelled on the 20 requests in fork/research/scripts/bench_long_context.py (same 8 languages, same 3 answerable departments, same question), but written independently so that the pool can be scaled past n=20 and is label-balanced.
provenance.note: No text is copied from the upstream request list; the overlap is the task shape only. Numeric slots are drawn from one shared pool for every label and every language, so the digits a document contains carry no label signal. Languages rotate within each label, so language carries no label signal.
